stage.name: The Bone Zone
stage.type: Challenge stage (second challenge stage; unlocked by hyper mode on 3 normal stages, or the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane)
stage.spawn_type: Standard: enemies approach from all four sides of the player

modifiers.scaling_note: Every minute enemy health and speed multipliers increase by +0.3 and +0.05 respectively (additive), without a cap; additive with Inverse Mode.
effects: No item drops (light sources only drop Gold Coins, Small Coin Bags and Survarots).

stage.modifiers_note: Wiki infobox: enemy_speed x1.25 (+0.05/min), enemy_health x1 (+0.3/min), greed x1.5. Hyper: starting spawns 60, player/enemy speed x1.9, projectile speed x1.15, greed x2, enemy min x1.25. Not needed here.
stage.enemy_cap_rule: Periodic spawning stops while 300 or more enemies are alive; only bosses and map-event enemies can still spawn (Map event page).
stage.spawn_rule: Each minute's wave has a minimum enemy count and a spawn interval. If alive count < minimum, spawn until the quota is filled; otherwise spawn one of each enemy type in the wave per interval. Bosses are teleported back onto screen rather than despawned.
stage.map_event_chance_rule: Event chance is divided by player Luck (chanceWithLuck = eventChance / totalLuck); evaluated per repeat; no chance or 0 means guaranteed.

relics.position: Defeat Sketamari (10,800 HP, speed 220, damage 40) 5 tilesets due south of start, moving back and forth horizontally

stage.destructibles: Light sources only (spawn attempts twice as often; drop only Gold Coins, Small Coin Bags, Survarots).

layout.size_note: Not stated on the wiki page. Sketamari patrols 5 tilesets each side, 5 tilesets south of start; hidden items lie in the four cardinal directions, so treat as a roughly square arena (exact size unknown).
layout.obstacles: Unknown; wiki gives no obstacle details (light sources only). Assume sparse.
layout.theme: Calcified bone cavern: a dark cave of skeletons and skulls (wiki: 'calcified carnage where the dead go to live'; music based on Castlevania's Skeleton Cave theme; earlier a detuned Dairy Plant theme).
layout.special_mechanics: Challenge stage. NO ITEM DROPS: light sources only drop Gold Coins, Small Coin Bags and Survarots. Enemies grow stronger over time: each minute the enemy health multiplier rises by +0.3 and the enemy speed multiplier by +0.05 (additive, uncapped). Greed x1.5. Hidden Sketamari mini-boss south of start drops the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane (needs Yellow Sign). Guaranteed The Stalker at 10:00 and The Drowner (floods lower map) at 20:00. Reaper at 30:00.

waves.notes: Wiki: Skeleton (x4) and Horned Pile Shooter (Twin Demons).

events.note: Guaranteed at 10:00; 20% lower move speed before time bonuses.

waves.notes: 30:00+: all enemies cleared and The Reaper spawns; another Reaper each further minute.

skull_swarm.shape: fixed-direction cluster of Skullones beelining through screen centre, no collision, 15 s

dragon_stream.shape: Skeleton Stream: groups of serpentine Dragon Shrimp 3 cross horizontally, alternating sides

stalker.shape: one Stalker follows the player 60 s

pile_assault.shape: Skull Pile Pile: two columns of 12 stationary shooters either side of player

map_events.map_events_note: Event 'at' is the wave-minute start; Skull Swarm amounts are from the wave table (8:00 lists 20 though the Skull Swarm page says 32).

unsupported_events.wiki_description: The Drowner: guaranteed at 20:00, lasts 1 minute; floods the lower part of the map dealing 20 damage per tick.

unsupported_events_note: The Drowner (20:00) has no matching EVENT_KIND (floods the lower map). Everything else maps to existing kinds.

bosses.name: Colossal Skeleton
bosses.note: Can exceptionally evolve up to 3 weapons if a higher tier chest with enough rewards is received.

chest_rules.roll_order: 5-item chance first, then 3-item, then 1-item; each chance is multiplied by player Luck; compared to a random 0-100 per roll; fallback_level is the chest tier if all fail.
chest_rules.evo: If an evolution is available, evo-flagged chests can evolve a weapon (generally one per chest); the wiki table's evo flag meaning is inferred from the treasure template.
chest_rules.reward_flags_note: reward1/reward4/reward5 flags exist in the treasure template; their exact meaning is not documented on the pages read (unknown).
chest_rules.wiki_table_parse_note: First-minute-of-stage values: '1:00 ... evo=1' etc. copied verbatim; a blank evo means not evolving.
chest_rules.fractional_chance_note: Minute 3 Giant Mummy chest lists a 0.1% 5-item chance; code that int()s the chance reads it as 0.

reaper.spawn: 30:00 (all on-screen enemies cleared), then one additional Reaper each minute afterwards (unless endless mode)
reaper.hp_note: multiplied by player level when spawned (HP x Level)
reaper.knockback_note: negative: hits drag it toward the player
reaper.behaviour: Rushes the player and deals 65,535 damage, ending the run. Surviving to the end rewards 500 gold (revive bonuses stack +100 each up to +400). Orologion/other freeze can freeze it per wiki text (wiki lists freeze resistance 1 but the text says freezing is possible - contradictory; Orologion freeze goes through freeze resistance).

light_sources.spawn_chance: 40% base (stage, max 40%), multiplied by Luck; wiki: light sources attempt to spawn twice as often
light_sources.spawn_location: predetermined possible spawn locations in this stage (Light source page); Mad Forest spawns them in an oval around the player
light_sources.cap_behaviour: when at cap, a new spawn appears nearest the player and the oldest despawns
light_sources.luck_note: Luck increases chance of pickups other than Gold Coin and Coin Bag.
light_sources.drops_note: The Bone Zone: light sources only drop Gold Coins, Small Coin Bags and Survarots (Survarot only for characters who can find them; not modelled). No other item drops.
